countryMatrix.joinMethod: Exact country-code match to the official displayed Shopify-app supported-country/language table. Language match is exact; pt-BR is not silently normalized to pt. English is available in all 36 app-table-matched countries. A missing optional supported local language is an expansion opportunity, not a universal eligibility failure.
countryMatrix.merchantEligibilityCaution: App table match does not prove country free-listing eligibility, selected sync destinations, received offers or live checkout. Countries not listed in this app table are not inferred to be unsupported in all Google programs.
